comment: First-party plugin catalog, embedded into the orca binary via include_str! in plugin_manager.rs. Adding a first-party plugin = adding one entry here. 'status' is 'available' for plugins whose external repo + cdylib artifact exist and are installable today, or 'planned' for first-party plugins not yet extracted to their own repo. Slice 5 wires auto-download of 'available' entries; today only sideload (plugin.install --file) installs anything. One catalog entry == one cdylib artifact: 'name'/'targetSoftware' must match the cdylib's target_software() header (drives the lib<name>.dylib filename + load match). A single cdylib may expose several tool namespaces — e.g. the 'arr' plugin bundles sonarr/radarr/prowlarr/lidarr (see its README). No hostnames or IPs — public GitHub repo URLs only.
